description: This source file defines utilities and functions related to managing the gateway environment for the OpenClaw application. It includes version comparison, environment checks, command resolution, and installation routines for the gateway component, as well as parsing and handling gateway version data.

classes.name: Semver
classes.description: A lightweight semantic versioning helper supporting parsing, comparison, and compatibility checks.

classes.name: GatewayEnvironmentKind
classes.description: Enumeration representing different kinds of gateway environment states.

classes.name: GatewayEnvironmentStatus
classes.description: Structure encapsulating the status of the gateway environment including its kind, versions, and message.

classes.name: GatewayCommandResolution
classes.description: Represents the outcome of resolving a gateway command, including the environment status and command details.

methods.name: gatewayPort
methods.description: Determines the port number for the gateway, using environment variables, config, or default.

methods.name: expectedGatewayVersion
methods.description: Parses the expected gateway version if specified.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive check of the current gateway environment, version compatibility, and availability.

methods.name: resolveGatewayCommand
methods.description: Resolves and constructs the command line to run the gateway, considering environment and configuration.

methods.name: installGlobal
methods.description: Installs or upgrades the global openclaw gateway CLI, using npm, pnpm, or bun.

methods.name: normalizeGatewayVersionOutput
methods.description: Normalizes raw version output from the gateway process for parsing.

methods.name: readGatewayVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of the gateway binary by executing it with '--version'.

methods.name: readLocalGatewayVersion
methods.description: Reads the gateway version from a local 'package.json' in the project root.
